subject: LumenWorks throughput incident — readout, commitments, and action log
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@lumenworks.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenWorks OnCall <oncall@lumenworks.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: sudden throughput drop impacting checkout — urgent

Hi Priyom / Lauren,

We experienced a sharp throughput degradation starting ~07:50 PT that impacted checkout latency for ~18 minutes. Error rates spiked to ~6% for generation requests and we see orders queuing upstream. We've opened INC-4921 and oncall is looking but this needs account-level visibility. Can someone confirm whether this aligns with any rollout/optimizer changes on your side?

Impact: ~30% of requests delayed >2s, increased retries from our gateway, customer-visible errors.

Attaching a brief sample of logs. Please advise next steps and ETA to resolution.

—Samir
Senior SRE, LumenWorks
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden throughput drop impacting checkout — urgent

Thanks Samir — looping in ops/infra. We're triaging now. Initial checks: no scheduled canary or rollout in the window; autoscaler observed a small spike in queue latency coincident with spiky request bursts.

Action plan (first 30m):
- Grace: run kernel-level hotpath sampling and KV cache checks, priority now (owner: grace)
- Marissa: pull tracing spans and queue depth metrics + correlate with regional routing (owner: marissa)
- Karthik: prepare a customer-facing summary for exec readout and confirm SLA credit eligibility (owner: karthik)

I'll keep Samir updated here. If we discover a regression, we will issue rollback/fallback per playbook.

—Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: sudden throughput drop impacting checkout — urgent

On 2027-06-13 09:05, priyom_das wrote:
> I'm triaging now. Initial checks: no scheduled canary or rollout in the window...

Results from hotpath sampling: we observed an anomalous MV cache miss spike in shard-us-west-2-1 that amplified tokenization overhead for many short requests; KV-cache hit-rate dropped from 96% to 74% in the 07:48–08:06 window. No model binary changes.

Hypothesis: a transient cache invalidation combined with a burst of short-lived connections caused inefficient batching and increased per-token work. Continuing to pull complete trace sets and ingest-level metrics.

Attaching sanity_check_logs_0613.tar.gz for reference.

—Grace
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenworks.com>, Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@lumenworks.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-14T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: LumenWorks incident — interim readout and corrective measures

Hi Samir / Ellen,

Thanks again for the quick signal and logs — below is our interim readout and near-term commitments. This will be followed by a formal RCA document and an action tracker we will update until closure.

Summary (what happened)
- Window: 2027-06-13 07:48–08:06 PT
- Symptom: throughput drop + elevated error rate (peak ~6%) for generation endpoints serving checkout flow
- Root cause (interim): transient MV/KV cache invalidation in shard-us-west-2-1 combined with atypical bursty request shape that reduced batching efficiency

Immediate mitigations performed
- Increased short-request batching thresholds for affected routers (grace, done 08:12)
- Warmed KV cache replica and adjusted TTLs to reduce invalidation spikes (grace)
- Applied temporary routing weight shift away from the affected shard to spread load (marissa, 08:22)

Customer commitments (owner / ETA)
- Deliver formal RCA doc (marissa) — 2027-06-15 17:00 PT — attached: lumen_rca_v1.pdf
- Provide action tracker with owners and dates (karthik) — 2027-06-15 17:30 PT — attached: lumen_action_tracker_v1.xlsx
- Add automated cache anomaly alert to reduce time-to-detect (grace) — target 2027-06-30
- Review batching heuristics for short-request heavy workloads and ship a tuned policy for LumenWorks (lauren) — target 2027-07-07

We believe these mitigations remove the immediate customer impact and reduce recurrence risk; we will keep you updated in the tracker and share follow-up verification runs.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenworks.com>, Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@lumenworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-14T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenWorks incident — interim readout and corrective measures

Samir / Ellen — attached are the RCA and the action tracker (links above and attached copies). Short summary of business-facing commitments:
- RCA delivered with timelines & test evidence
- Action tracker lists 7 items; 4 are high-priority for the next two weeks
- We will run two post-change verification windows with LumenWorks traffic patterns (dates proposed in tracker)

Please review the tracker and let us know if you need the delivery dates adjusted. If acceptable, we'll schedule a 30-minute readout with your execs next week to review closure steps.

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: lumen_rca_v1.pdf, lumen_action_tracker_v1.xlsx
From: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@lumenworks.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@lumenworks.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenWorks incident — interim readout and corrective measures

Thanks for the clear readout and fast follow-up. One request: can you prioritize adding an automated alert when KV hit-rate drops >10% in any shard for >3m? That would have saved us a chunk of triage time. If you can mark that as P0 in the tracker, we'll be much more comfortable.

Also available for the readout on 2027-06-17 10:00 PT if that works.

—Ellen
Dir, Platform Engineering, LumenWorks
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-15T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Action tracker update — marking alerts P0 and next steps

Status update for closure:
- Added KV-hit-rate alert (threshold: 10% drop sustained 3m) — owner: grace_oconnor — target: 2027-06-21 — STATUS: In progress
- Verification runs scheduled with LumenWorks traffic replay — owner: lauren_bishop — dates: 2027-06-20 and 2027-06-27 — STATUS: Confirmed
- Batching heuristic review scoped and assigned — owner: lauren_bishop — target: 2027-07-07 — STATUS: In progress
- SLA credit assessment: eligible for partial credit per contract — preparing note for finance (owner: karthik_iyer) — ETA: 2027-06-18

I've attached the updated lumen_action_tracker_v1.xlsx (versioned). We'll keep this thread as the canonical exec-facing log until closure.

—Karthik
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
